summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026) with applied experience building computer vision and image processing pipelines for inspection and detection systems. Developed a metal surface inspection pipeline at BARC using image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation; trained U-Net segmentation models on multi-modal MRI data; deployed TensorRT YOLO on Jetson for real-time visual servoing.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.
Achieved PSNR of 86 with a custom wavelet bank + optimized stitching; homography baseline reached PSNR of 65.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8 classification model improving accuracy from 78% to 97.5%; deployed in a consumer mobile app.
Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation models with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI data; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU.
Engineered a custom data pipeline with medical imaging augmentation and memory-efficient batch loading for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.
Developed a gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi Pico and Bluetooth; translated 3-DoF motion into HID commands via Python.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency; resolved 11 integration failures including false-positive detections and rolling-shutter stereo depth errors.
Deployed TensorRT YOLO at ~18 FPS with ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping; implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory; 49.2ms vs. 73.3ms (uncoalesced) — ~35% speedup, 1.5–2× over CPU baseline.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
